recommendation: Keep the commit as a narrow source correction for FHIR-24644. Do not broaden this issue into unrelated CanonicalResource pattern alignment or separate MessageHeader work without a new issue-specific reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-24644 was a Published/Persuasive InM change request, applied for R5, asking that MessageDefinition.url read as the canonical URL for a MessageDefinition and MessageDefinition.identifier read as a business identifier instead of a server primary key.
initial_application: Commit 4aa5f54b169ae5986325ddc3c1a38c6943ae917c applied the issue by changing MessageDefinition.url.short and MessageDefinition.identifier.short. The identifier short was already correct in current source, but the URL short retained the issue text's misspelling 'cannonical'.
additional_context: MessageDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini as a current resource owned by InM and marked normative. The old and requested strings match ElementDefinition.short values, so broader URL and identifier definition text and CanonicalResource pattern divergences were left unchanged. Confluence references cite FHIR-24644 in InM minutes and as background for FHIR-31055, but no direct Zulip or Confluence full-text hit changed the seed interpretation.
reconciliation: Changed source/messagedefinition/structuredefinition-MessageDefinition.xml so MessageDefinition.url.short says 'The canonical URL for a given MessageDefinition' and made the same spelling correction in source/messagedefinition/messagedefinition-definition-mapping-exceptions.xml.
source_changes: source/messagedefinition/messagedefinition-definition-mapping-exceptions.xml: synchronized the mapped resource short text with the corrected MessageDefinition.url.short.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-31055 and InM minutes cite FHIR-24644 while deciding a separate MessageHeader.response.identifier issue; it was not decided here because it concerns a different artifact and did not affect the MessageDefinition source fix.
